conceptZh: 一隻超小的玩具恐龍深吸一大口氣、身體鼓得像顆球，準備噴出驚天動地的火焰——結果只吐出一顆小泡泡，泡泡飄上去啪一聲破在牠自己鼻子上，牠還是超級得意地抬起頭。
object: a very small chubby toy dragon
morph: the glyph 龍 stands still as a solid sculpture while the tiny dragon tries to breathe fire beside it
creativeAngle: 孩子喜歡恐龍與戰鬥感，但把「噴火」換成一顆小泡泡，用期待與結果的巨大落差製造笑點，也完全避開火焰與嚇人畫面。龍十六畫結構複雜，字體全程靜止當舞台。語音詞「恐龍」，恐ㄎㄨㄥˇ、龍ㄌㄨㄥˊ都是單一讀音。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second 3D stylized toy animation as one continuous locked-off shot on a clean solid light cream background. One correctly formed Traditional Chinese character 龍 stands centered the whole time as a flat-fronted sculpture in saturated deep emerald green, filling about 70% of the frame height with comfortable margins on all sides. Use standard textbook proportions: the 立 over 月 stack on the left and the tall hooked right side with its three short horizontal strokes stay clearly separated, with every stroke evenly spaced. The glyph never moves, rotates, tilts or gets covered, and the camera stays locked. Beside its lower right stands a very small, very round toy dragon with stubby wings and one crooked tooth. From 0.7 seconds it plants its feet, closes its eyes and inhales enormously, swelling up rounder and rounder until it is almost a ball, wings trembling with effort. Hold that over-inflated pose for a beat. At 2.5 seconds it snaps forward and lets go - and produces one small soap bubble, which drifts lazily upward. The dragon watches it rise. At 3.4 seconds the bubble pops softly on the dragon's own nose. It blinks, deflates back to normal size, and then lifts its chin with tremendous pride, as if that had gone exactly to plan. By 4.6 seconds it struts out of frame to the right. From 4.7 seconds to 8.0 seconds the frame is completely still and clean, holding on the single centered 龍 with nothing else in shot. Style: Pixar-like glossy chunky toy materials, soft studio lighting, bright high-contrast colors that are vivid but never neon, no dark or moody grading, no white blowouts. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin and says exactly 「龍、龍、恐龍」, using the reading ㄌㄨㄥˊ for 龍 both on its own and inside the word. Speak the first 龍 around 0.5 seconds, the second around 2.0 seconds, and 恐龍 around 5.6 seconds while the finished glyph is held still, with natural pauses, then stop; do not keep chanting the character or repeat the line. Keep every sound effect soft and clear of the voice, and use no music louder than the voice. The spoken word is audio only and must not be added to the picture. The only writing anywhere in the frame is the single character 龍: no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no other letters, numbers, watermarks, scenery, extra props, particles, lens flare, motion blur on the glyph, or flashing effects.

conceptZh: 愛耍帥的披風英雄想擺出恐龍姿勢，過長的披風卻翻過頭，把自己包成大鼻子的布恐龍。他摸摸鼻尖，乾脆順勢表演恐龍點頭，得意退場。
object: An original caped action-figure hero with a cape three sizes too long, its hem tailored into a soft dinosaur-head profile.
morph: The oversized cape flips over the hero's head and becomes a floppy dinosaur puppet. The centered 龍 remains a correctly formed, stationary glyph throughout.
creativeAngle: 把噴泡泡的舊笑點改成英雄被自己的披風反將一軍：耍帥失敗後，意外變成布恐龍，再順勢完成表演。複雜的「龍」全程保持完整，以旁側的披風動作連結字義，避免變形造成筆畫混淆。
promptEn:
Create an exactly 8-second stylized 3D toy animation in one continuous locked frontal shot. On a light warm cream background, display the single Traditional Chinese glyph 龍 centered and uncropped, occupying approximately 70% of frame height with generous margins. Render it in saturated deep teal using an accurately formed standard Taiwanese textbook typeface, with crisp strokes and clearly open internal spaces. Keep its geometry, position and color fixed throughout. Use a wide composition with a separate performance area in the right margin, leaving every stroke unobstructed.

The lead is an original, extravagantly confident caped action-figure hero: obvious molded plastic joints, oversized mitten hands, a round orange helmet and a plain lavender suit without an emblem. His soft coral cape is three sizes too long. Its trailing hem has a broad, rounded dinosaur-snout profile, two embroidered eyes and a few soft triangular fabric spikes, all integrated into the same cape. There are no additional characters or props.

At 0.0–1.3 seconds, the tiny hero stands proudly beside the lower right of 龍, curls his hands into dinosaur claws and takes an exaggerated preparatory breath. He throws his arms up for a magnificent dinosaur pose. At 1.3–2.5 seconds, that flourish whips the enormous cape forward over his own helmet: FLOMP. The dinosaur-shaped hem lands over his face, its absurdly long soft snout drooping almost to his feet. Pause briefly on the ridiculous silhouette, with his little claw hands still frozen in their grand pose. At 2.5–3.3 seconds, he feels along the unexpected snout, lifts its tip and gives a delighted little body bounce as he discovers the puppet. At 3.3–4.7 seconds, he intentionally makes the fabric dinosaur perform one grand, slow nod, then proudly shuffles out through the right edge with the cape gathered in his hands. Finish all movement by 4.7 seconds. From 4.7 to 8.0 seconds, hold completely still on the clean, centered 龍 alone.

Use bright, softly lit toy materials and readable silhouettes. The gag comes from the oversized cape swallowing the hero's carefully rehearsed pose, followed by his resourceful recovery. Keep the cloth action confined to the side performance area. No camera motion, flashing effects or decorative clutter.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin, saying exactly 「龍、龍、恐龍」. Pronounce 龍 as ㄌㄨㄥˊ. Speak the first 龍 at approximately 0.3–0.9 seconds, the second at 1.1–1.7 seconds, and 恐龍 at 5.4–6.4 seconds during the final stationary glyph hold. Allow natural pauses and stop after the word. Add only a quiet cloth flop and soft plastic footsteps beneath the narration; no music or other vocalizations. The vocabulary is audio only. The only visible writing is 龍, with no subtitles, extra glyphs, logos or watermarks.
